newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila to raise T-bond offering due to liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Manila to raise T-bond offering due to liquidity.

text.p: The Philippine auction committee said on Monday it would raise its five-year fixed rate Treasury bond offering this month to four billion pesos from 3.5 billion.
"We are increasing our offering to accommodate the higher liquidity in the market," Treasurer Caridad Valdehuesa told reporters. Valdehuesa is the vice chairman of the auction committee.
The five-year T-bond auction is scheduled on June 17.
The announcement came after the auction committee increased the weekly auction offering of 91-day Treasury bills to 1.5 billion pesos from 1.0 billion.
The offerings of 182-day and 364-day T-bills were kept unchanged at 1.5 billion and two billion pesos.
The committee also did not change the offering of the two-year fixed rate Treasury bond, due to be auctioned on June 10, at 4.0 billion pesos.
